data.sql: SELECT commerce.inventory.product_id AS product_id, $1 AS before_date, $2 AS after_date, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $3 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_before, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $4 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_after, MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $5 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) - MAX(CASE WHEN commerce.inventory.snapshot_date = $6 THEN commerce.inventory.stock_on_hand END) AS stock_delta FROM commerce.inventory JOIN commerce.products ON inventory.product_id = products.product_id WHERE commerce.inventory.snapshot_date IN ($7, $8) GROUP BY commerce.inventory.product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT commerce.inventory.snapshot_date) = $9 ORDER BY commerce.inventory.product_id LIMIT 200
